data.one_liner: Adds actions stream to Bloc and Cubit to process UI events like dialogs or snackbars.
data.what_it_does: Extends Bloc and Cubit with a mixin to dispatch one-off UI actions that are separate from state changes. Provides a BlocActionListener widget to listen to and process these actions in the UI.
use_when: You need to show dialogs or snackbars from a Bloc or Cubit without tying them to state changes
You want a dedicated UI action stream alongside your flutter_bloc architecture
avoid_when: State changes alone are sufficient for driving your UI side effects
You are not using flutter_bloc in your application
strengths: Simplifies triggering one-off UI events from business logic
Familiar API style matching standard flutter_bloc patterns
weaknesses: Adds an extra layer of abstraction for side effects

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer managing state and side effects strictly via the standard state stream without a separate action mechanism.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to rely purely on built-in state listeners for UI communication.
